purpose: Teach: 捉える/深海/追放/パンク/捏造/形跡/失調/大名

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市場動向、本気で、絶対、捉える、絶対、分析、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to grasp market trends, analyze them thoroughly, and move forward on this. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, measured authority. Each directive lands with quiet weight. Lean forward slightly on the key verbs. No softening—this matters. Steady eye contact, minimal gesture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、深海、絶対、調査、絶対、案件、絶対、受注、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've completed the deep-sea survey project and secured the contract. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight formality in posture. Even delivery, each fact placed carefully. Pride underneath but not performed. Small pause before the gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、追放、絶対、された慣行、絶対、しないようにしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure we don't repeat the practices that got us into trouble before. I need absolute assurance on this.
lines.style: Firmer than before. The word 'don't' carries weight. Not angry—more a quiet restatement of non-negotiable boundaries. Slight lean back, suggesting this should be obvious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバー、本気で、絶対、パンク、絶対、対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're already moving on server capacity issues. The countermeasures are underway.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Professional update delivered without filler. Each clause precise. Shows competence through brevity. Slightly faster pace than his first line.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、データ、絶対、捏造、絶対、なきよう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Data integrity is non-negotiable. I want zero tolerance for anything that looks like fabrication. Enforce it.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. The word 'zero' carries particular weight. No room for interpretation. Eyes steady, jaw set slightly. Speaking to a standard, not a person.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い販促の、本気で、絶対、形跡、絶対、まだ、絶対、残っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're still finding traces of the old promotional practices in the system. We're cleaning them out now.
lines.style: Slightly apologetic undertone without sounding defensive. Honest about the delay. Pace stays even. Shows he's on top of it despite the problem still existing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、失調、絶対、防止、絶対、職場改善、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to prioritize workplace culture and staff wellbeing. Prevent burnout before it starts. Make those improvements.
lines.style: Shifts slightly—less hard-edged. These directives land with care alongside authority. Breathe slightly deeper. The tone suggests this comes from principle, not just mandate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、旧、絶対、大名、絶対、家所縁の、絶対、商品、絶対、限定販売中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're currently running a limited release of our heritage collection—products connected to the old daimyo family line. It's performing well.
lines.style: Subtle pride in this update. Slightly lighter energy than the previous lines. Shows he understands this is a positive note to end on. Pace relaxes just slightly.
